title: From the Special Period to today: crisis, reforms and emigration
goal: Tell the economic history of Cuba since 1991 with por más que, and say who gives which explanation.
grammar: concessive clauses with por mas que and subjunctive

items: I can say that nothing changes however much something happens, with *por más que* and *por mucho que* (Cuba).
I can say what the Special Period was and when the Soviet Union ended.
I can use the new words for blackouts, shortages and rafts.
